# MapLibre GL JS 6.14.0

Official npm release, vendored unchanged from https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.14.0/ on 2026-10-12. BSD-3-Clause and bundled dependency notices are in LICENSE.txt. Files were verified against the npm CDN's SHA-256 integrity metadata. No runtime CDN request or paid API key is needed. The ESM module is loaded only when selecting 3D terrain; serve `.mjs` as JavaScript over HTTP(S).
